transcript: Speaker 1 @0.0s [en]: Good morning everyone. Thanks for joining the weekly planning meeting for the mobile app redesign.
Speaker 2 @7.2s [en]: Morning. I reviewed the design files yesterday and I have a few concerns about the onboarding flow.

Speaker 1 @110.9s [en]: All right. Let's make lazy loading the priority for the next sprint.

Speaker 2 @131.5s [en]: Will do.
Speaker 2 @133.0s [en]: Is there anything else we need to cover today?

Speaker 1 @137.5s [en]: Thanks everyone, and see you next week.

Speaker 1 @145.9s [en]: Sorry about that, I had to take a quick call.
Speaker 1 @149.0s [en]: Where were we?
